> **Conclusion first**: **It is true — but SpaceX is not a party.** On 2026-11-02 (Mon), three watchdog groups (CREW, Public Citizen, POGO) filed suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia against the **Department of Defense, Defense Secretary Hegseth and Under Secretary for Research and Engineering Emil Michael**. The defendants are government only, and the claim is that the advisory panel Hegseth established by a 9/30 memo, **'Project Meridian: The Future of Warfare'**, violated the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA — charter, balanced membership, open meetings, records disclosure), and the plaintiffs ask the court to **void the memo, bar its activities until it complies with the law, disclose its records, and prevent action on its recommendations**. Musk is a **co-director** of this panel (per the DoD announcement) along with Luckey (Anduril) and Gingrich, and the complaint states that 19 of the 21 members are civilians and that Musk and Luckey are "leaders and stakeholders of major defense contractors." **No ruling on the merits or on a preliminary injunction** (no reports of an injunction motion), the DoD and MITRE have not responded, and Musk's special government employee (SGE) status has been undisclosed since October. There is no SpaceX 8-K, IR or statement (latest EDGAR 8-K: 10/26). Therefore **no change in the judgments on the 29 milestones · no rules triggered · probabilities 25/50/25 · probability-weighted $32 unchanged**.
